column1: # Challenge Keyword Finder - guide links per challenge (hand-made, edit freely).
# match  = words in the challenge name (whole words, any case). "Cultist" matches "Kill a Cultist" and "Kill Cultists..." only if spelled the same - add both forms if needed.
# guide  = guide_index.tsv id, or the page URL (/df/...).
# action = add (default) or remove (stops an automatic match from showing).
